text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco and Japan set up joint friendship and parliamentary cooperation group.
- United Nations Development Programme and Morocco to devote a total of $2 million to fight urban and rural poverty in Morocco.
- Health workers start three-day strike to press for pay increases and other benefits.
- Six members of the same family sentenced to five years in jail for stealing seven kgs (15.4 pounds) of cocaine, which was part of the amount which washed up on Moroccan beaches recently.
- Moroccan-Egyptian commission studies two draft projects over setting up a free trade zone with Egypt.
